sources.title: Twinkie-2B: Child-Safe Learning Assistant - GitHub
sources.snippet: Twinkie-2B is an open-source, child-safe learning companion tailored specifically for children aged 6 to 12. Fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-2B using Unsloth LoRA on a single consumer/free T4 GPU, Twinkie provides patient, encouraging, and age-appropriate educational guidance while enforcing rigorous defense-in-depth safety boundaries.
